item.description: The SendGrid plugin constructor expects a parameter named 'from_addr' (line 172), but tests expect 'from_email' based on the template configuration (line 105 in the template). This creates a mismatch between the API signature and the expected usage.
item.contract: The constructor should accept 'from_email' parameter to match template expectations and maintain backward compatibility with existing usage patterns.

item.description: The Nextcloud plugin URL formatting in the url() method (line 359) doesn't properly handle user targets with '@' prefix. The current implementation strips the '@' prefix when building URLs, but it should preserve it for proper user identification.
item.contract: The url() method should preserve '@' prefix for user targets in the URL representation to ensure proper privacy handling and URL formatting.

item.description: The Slack plugin's URL parsing logic in parse_url() method doesn't correctly handle webhook token formats, particularly when parsing tokens from native Slack URLs. This causes incorrect URL parsing for webhook-based configurations.
item.contract: The parse_url() method should correctly parse and handle webhook token formats including native Slack URLs with token patterns like 'https://hooks.slack.com/services/TOKEN_A/TOKEN_B/TOKEN_C'.

item.description: The Resend plugin constructor signature differs from SendGrid plugin, expecting 'from_addr' instead of 'from_email'. This inconsistency makes it difficult to implement uniform behavior across email-based notification plugins.
item.contract: The Resend plugin constructor should accept 'from_email' parameter to maintain API consistency with SendGrid plugin and other email-based plugins.
